paragraphs.text: Postel MCP server: find what's going viral in your niche, write your version in your own voice, and
schedule it to X, LinkedIn, Bluesky and Mastodon from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Gemini CLI
Find what's going viral in your niche, write your version in your own voice, and schedule it, withou
t leaving Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client.
Postel is an AI writing and scheduling tool for people who post as themselves: founders, consultants
and creators. This repository holds the public side of its hosted MCP server: setup for every clien
t, the Claude Code plugin, the Gemini CLI extension, an agent skill and the MCP Registry entry. The
server runs at `https://www.postel.app/api/mcp`; there is nothing to install or host.
- **Start from what's working.** Postel keeps a library of posts that took off for real creators, sc
ored by how far each one beat its author's usual reach. Your assistant searches it by topic and show

s you why the top ones worked.
- **Sound like you.** Drafts come from your voice profile (built from

your own X or LinkedIn posts) and the facts you saved, not from a generic template.
- **Schedule wh
ere you post.** X (posts and threads), personal LinkedIn profiles, Bluesky, Mastodon, YouTube and Ti
kTok, through each network's official API, after you approve.

## What it doesn't do

- It doesn't read your timeline, feed, mentions, DMs or messages on any network.
- It doesn't like,
reply, follow, comment on other people's posts or send connection requests. It is for publishing you

r own posts, not outreach.
- It never asks for your passwords or cookies, and it doesn't drive a bro

wser. Posts go through each network's official API with the permissions you grant.
- Images and vide
o come from public URLs, up to 100 MB. Local files and LinkedIn PDF carousels go in the Postel edito

r.
- It doesn't show YouTube analytics, set thumbnails or playlists, or read video transcripts.
- Re
search searches Postel's indexed library, not live X, and the engagement numbers are snapshots.
